items.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: Just like John Coltrane, his measurement was, what was that Coltrane —

ctx.x: [scats] Yeah. That was “High Society.” Now that was written by Picou — he wrote that for the flute. It wasn’t a clarinet thing. But it became a clarinet thing, it was a way of measuring the musician’s ability. If you can play “High Society,” see, then you had the ability to play in the band you know. It was a measuring stick, see? Just like John Coltrane, his measurement was, what was that Coltrane —
